title: Daily Routine Steps
hook: Use the chart, then adapt to the day.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D daily-routine storybook, simple home actions and objects, clean morning-evening scenes; visual identity: Daily Routine Steps

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child following an adaptable daily sequence
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Daily Routine Steps a flexible sequence from wake/wash/dress/eat/pack/leave through return/clean/rest; charts support memory but the household can reorder or skip steps.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows transitions and distinguishes child-safe participation from adult heat/powered tasks.
